summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Avero SaaS. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me/logout, forgot-password identical response, invalid reset token), onboarding (invalid GST rejected, valid GST accepted, persistence), pricing (public + admin), non-admin 403, admin stats, full order->KOT->bill flow for restaurant with server-computed subtotal/tax/total (400/17.5/367.5 verified) and table state transitions (available->occupied->cleaning), cafe orders NOT creating KOT, inventory adjust + transactions log, dashboard (business_type, 7d revenue_series, kot/table status), reports for all 4 ranges, CRUD sanity, and CRITICAL data isolation across customers/menu-items/tables/inventory/orders/kot/payments/expenses (cross-business PUT/DELETE returns 404 and list endpoints strictly scoped). Frontend: Landing countdown visible with launch announcement; signup->onboarding 7 steps (welcome->referral->business-type cafe->subscription->business info->compliance GST/FSSAI->summary->finish) reached dashboard; cafe sidebar excludes KOT nav (0 count) as expected; logout works; re-login of onboarded user goes directly to /app dashboard (onboarding_completed persisted).

minor.issue: Emails are lowercased server-side (correct) but not reflected in the OpenAPI/docs; only a test-side annoyance.

issues: Announcement pill shows 'TEST_updated announcement' because admin PATCH test updated the announcement. Main agent may want to reset pricing_config.announcement back to production copy after testing.

OPTIONAL: Consider adding a top-level 'new-order-btn' testid on the dashboard (currently only appears in Orders tab). Not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 740-line file — consider splitting into modules (auth, business, orders, admin, crud_factory) if it grows further.
get_pricing_config re-inserts default doc if missing but does not upsert-on-miss safely under concurrency; harmless in practice.
CORS allow_origins uses FRONTEND_URL fallback to http://localhost:3000 — production preview host is in FRONTEND_URL so ok, but consider validating.

Orders bill endpoint sets kot to 'served' on billing which is fine, but consumer note: KOT PUT status sync map does not include 'accepted' (only preparing/ready/served) — accepted->order status is not synced. Low priority.
Data isolation is enforced via require_business + business_id filter on every query — verified robust across 8+ resource types.
